description.value: A Taco Bell fast food location in Sardis serving Tex-Mex inspired menu items including tacos, burritos, and the Crunchwrap Supreme. The location offers both drive-thru and dine-in service, as well as online ordering and delivery. As a chain fast food stop along Luckakuck Way, it could serve as a quick calorie refuel point for cyclists passing through Sardis.
